security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG emulates mseccfg.MML or mseccfg.MMWP as non-sticky (writable to 0 without PMP reset), allowing guest M-mode to clear these lockdown bits at runtime, or emulates mseccfg.RLB as settable while a locked PMP entry exists, violating the RLB lock-out semantics
security_spec.summary: Incorrect emulation of Smepmp stictky/lock-out bits in mseccfg and redefined pmpcfg.L semantics enables guest M-mode to bypass M-mode-only PMP enforcement, allowing privilege escalation from S/U-mode to M-mode memory access
